notes.title: Achievement Changes Part 2
notes.content:
This new build has updates for two of the achievements. They were both very grindy achievements.
[list]
[*] The play 1,000 hands achievement is now a 500 hands achievement
[*] The win 1,000,000 total chips achievement has been reduced to 500,000 chips.
[/list]

notes.title: Achievement Adjustments
notes.content:
I just made some adjustments to the achievements for a few of them that were a problem.

The 8,000 chip achievement is now a 6,000 chip achievement. Getting 8,000 chips is just way way too hard.

The Big Board achievement has now been set to the Level Ten achievement.

I've also made it so the requirements for each achievement are shown on the Awards screen in the game so it is very clear what is needed to get them.

This new build is version "1.2.2.0" which you can see in the upper right corner of the main menu screen. Sometimes Steam takes a little bit of time to update so if that isn't the version showing then it is still the previous version running.

Kevin

Now heading back to work on this which is coming out in late June.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/683660/Minigolf_Blast/

notes.title: An Update!
notes.content:
I just posted an update on my other two games:

Contraption Maker
https://store.steampowered.com/app/241240/Contraption_Maker/

...and...

Minigolf Blast (not released yet - hopefully sometime this century)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/683660/Minigolf_Blast/


...so, I figured I'd put an update here too even though there really isn't much to say anymore.

Puzzle Poker is pretty much done although I am thinking about adding a online head-to-head play.

We had some excitement here last September. The Creek Fire (almost 400,000 acres) came within a 1/2 mile of our home. Here our a couple of videos I filmed in the afternoon before we had to evacuate around midnight. We were allowed back home 3 weeks later.

Time lapse filmed from my home office when the fire was about 10 miles away:
